caption: The Desk Activity report
preconditions: Docs instance (run-capture-autodocs.sh): superdesk-analytics is installed and enabled, with archive statistics and scheduled reports on. PUBLISH_ASSOCIATED_ITEMS is on there, so Featuremedia Updates and Update Time are not registered.
Logged in as admin (administrator, so every 'Analytics - ...' privilege)
Done by seed_analytics.py: today the Politics desk had stories created, sent in from World, sent to World and back, published and spiked

Archive statistics built after seed_analytics.py ran: the server builds them once an hour, on the hour, so capture after the first full hour that follows the seed (GET /api/archive_statistics lists the seeded stories by then)

steps.script: (() => { const d = new Date(Date.now() - 6 * 864e5); const v = [String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0'), String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0'), d.getFullYear()].join('/'); const row = [...document.querySelectorAll('.sd-filters-panel .form__row-item')].find((e) => e.querySelector('label')?.textContent.trim() === 'From'); const input = row.querySelector('input'); input.value = v; ['input', 'change', 'blur'].forEach((t) => input.dispatchEvent(new Event(t, {bubbles: true}))); })()

steps: Wait for the chart (svg.highcharts-root) and the table below it (.sda-chart__table) to render
notes: Needs archive statistics; without them the report shows 'No data found'. The table has the Incoming (Total, Create, Fetch, Duplicate, Sent To, Deschedule, Unspike) and Outgoing (Total, Publish, Spike, Sent From, Publish Scheduled, Publish Embargo) column groups; the viewport is tall enough to show chart and table. The evaluate step types the date six days ago into From (DD/MM/YYYY, the client's view.dateformat), so the chart covers the last 7 days instead of the default 30. This version shows no 'Date Filter:' list for Desk Activity, only From and To: the client keeps a date filter only when its report config has a key for the selected interval ('daily' or 'hourly'), and the server's default config has none, so Range is the only filter. The report is picked from the report list instead of being opened by URL: on a cold page load of #/analytics?report=... the report controller can start before /api/report_configs has answered (reportConfigs.getConfig throws on the missing config) and the panel stays empty.

Seeded users have email addresses (seed.py: first.last@example.com), so the To: field can pick them
notes: Do not click Create; cleanup clicks Cancel. The saved report belongs to admin, so for admin it is listed under 'My Saved Reports' with a GLOBAL label; its three-dot menu only shows while the row is hovered. The modal heading reads 'Edit "<name>" Schedule' even for a new schedule (it uses the typed name), which is why a name is typed before the capture. Weekday checkboxes appear only for 'Weekly'. If the crop selector .modal__content does not match the sd-modal markup, crop to the element with class 'scheduled-reports'.
